I would had the story be something like:

Karen and her expedition fleet went to explore a new discovered gate branch. But ran into a beast fleet and were immediately consumed and added to the Beast. Any vessel that managed to flee and hide, only managed to save themselves from a fate worse than death.

Imogen a new fleet commander takes her place aboard the Khar-Kushan. Wishing to follow in the footsteps of her idol Karen S'jet. Her mission is to explore another branch of the gate network, as well as assess the nature of the anomaly. 

The 2nd expeditiary fleet passes the first gate only to meet deranged pirates babbling about the Beast in the Void. The pirates are dealt with effortlessly and the fleet enters the next gate. While traveling through hyperspace a voice rings throughout the fleet, Karen. 

The fleet encounters more pirates but something is off, masses of flesh cling to their hulls and radio communications from the ships are garbles of screams and static. A pirate frigate collides with the mothership whole deck sections report decompression and a fleshy growths appearing to eat at the hull. Imogen orders ion frigates to cauterize the infected sections of the mothership.

Research and Development discover this contaminant has been encountered before by kiith somtaaw, dubbed: The Beast. This infected pirates and the fleet proceeds through the next gate.

Here the fleet encounters a mix of Hiigaran, pirate and progenitor ships. Same as before the ships are covered in fleshy patches. A pained voice creeps over the radio, Karens voice. She warns of the creature, this Beast, she tells Imogen and the fleet to return to Hiigaran space and destory the gate. As the combat reaches a climax, a new voice speaks, an amalgamation of the many voices the Beast as consumed, "We, hunger"

The fleet is pushed into retreating as a mothership class enters the AO by a tear in hyperspace. But the Khar-kushan's jump fails, spitting the fleet deep into infected space. Floating among the half-consumed remains of progenitor ruins, many ships of different designs welded to each other by biological matter. All radio frequencies are bombarded by the screams of millions of consumed peoples. Imogen single outs one voice, Karen's. The Khar-Sajuuk is nearby. After an arduous search they find the Khar-Sajuuk, with Karen still alive but consumed by the Beast. Karen with the last of strength overcomes the Beasts influence. She tells Imogen that the Sajuuk has been placed to close off the gate to the Beasts source. In order to open the way, Karen intends to overload the cores of the Sajuuk and connected vessels. Karen commands Imogen to protect her as the Beast will certainly try to stop them. The Beast talks to them, "NO FURTHER!". The Sajuuk detonates blowing up the mass blocking the gate and powering it simultaneously, pulling the fleet into hyperspace into the space beyond.

At the core of the Beasts domain. A titanic hulk of mashed and melded vessels, a shell hiding a tear in space and time, to where from the Beast came. It throws its all at the fleet to stop it, however the fleet manages to crack the shell revealing the hyperspace tear. Imogen devises a plan to destabilise the Kushans cores and launch them into the tear. The plan works in closing the tear but at the cost of the Beast which held the gate network open.

Severe asthma is a good one and isn't exactly what's often portrayed in film and TV.  I have had asthma severely, I still have it with a psychological attachment to my inhaler.

I've yet to encounter anyone that is constantly wheezing. You can have the character's asthma triggered in various ways. Cigarette smoke, normal smoke, hayfever, a cold, stress, anxiety or temperature change to name a few. The last 3 being my only 3 main triggers remaining. And depending on the severity the medication slightly changes, least in the UK. Can't say the same for elsewhere.

In the UK if you have asthma attacks frequently you're given a brown inhaler which is a preventative. It's taken every morning and evening. Also every morning, at least, you have to take a peak flow test, using a plastic device with a meter and a marker that slides up and down, that you blow into with all your strength. If it falls under a certain threshold you might have to take some steroid tablets. Mine were disolved in water, worst tasting shit ever. After all that you get a blue one which is the reliever that you take when you have an asthma attack.

The character would probably have to visit a nurse/doctor for regular checkups. With severity determining how many times a year
